revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Asset name: achievement_medal_travel_tier_004
Primary request: Create one standalone watercolor travel journal achievement medal for the fourth travel tier, more advanced than earlier suitcase medals.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Subject: circular cream paper medal base with handmade scalloped edge, delicate pencil outline and watercolor texture. Center elements: open travel journal, small folded map, tiny compass, curved route line, two travel stamp shapes with no symbols or text. No people, no animals.
Style/medium: cozy TripPet watercolor scrapbook collectible, low-saturation but clear contrast, hand-painted, fine pencil linework, polished mobile game asset.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, readable as a small UI medal. Center objects darker and clearer than the pale base.
Color palette: ivory paper base, ochre and warm brown journal, dusty blue map, muted sage route, small coral accent. Avoid pure #00ff00 in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
